purpose: test whether a single fixed local boundary posterior-mass score has useful and speaker-consistent ranking signal
precondition: synthetic/static verification of boundary mapping, frame indexing, feature formulas, label independence, and R5 mechanism separation

execution.window: five nominal output steps k-2..k+2, clipped only to available output indices

registered_outputs: Addition-event valid anchor/window coverage over 342 events
positive-boundary valid anchor/window coverage over 324 boundary identities
speaker_disjoint_policy: Because the score is fixed and no model or normalization is fitted, each TRAIN speaker is reported as one held-out partition without calibration on that speaker or any other speaker.

F1.metric: valid anchor/window coverage over frozen Addition events

F4.metric: number of TRAIN speakers with ROC-AUC > 0.55

pass_rule: 4/4 gates -> R6_1_LOCAL_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE_FEASIBLE; only a separately named and preregistered development stage may follow
failure_rule: any valid gate failure -> R6_1_LOCAL_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE_NOT_CONFIRMED; stop this mechanism
technical_stop_rule: identity, mapping, undefined-speaker-AUC, coverage, or numerical failure is technical and must not be relabeled scientific failure
